header.title: Settings
header.subtitle: Configure the AI behavior, automation rules, and integrations for your workspace.

selectionMode.title: AI Selection Mode
selectionMode.subtitle: Automatic lets VoltDesk pick the best model. Manual gives you full control.

provider.title: AI Provider
provider.subtitle: Primary provider used for ticket classification, RAG suggestions, and reports.

costEstimator.title: Estimated cost per 1,000 classifications
costEstimator.subtitle: Based on ~800 tokens avg per ticket

fallback.title: Fallback Provider
fallback.subtitle: If the primary provider fails after 3 retries, VoltDesk automatically switches to this provider.
fallback.embeddingsNote: Embeddings always use OpenAI regardless of this setting — pgvector requires 1536-dim vectors.

assistant.title: Volt Copilot Model
assistant.subtitle: Optional override for the workspace assistant. Leave unset to reuse the model above.
assistant.customHelper: Choose a different model for the assistant

thresholds.title: Automation thresholds
thresholds.subtitle: Both conditions must be met before the AI agent attempts to resolve a ticket on its own.
thresholds.minUrgencyHelper: Tickets below this urgency score are always routed to a human agent, regardless of category.
thresholds.minConfidenceHelper: Cosine similarity against past resolved tickets — higher means stricter precedent matching.

hitl.title: Human-in-the-loop
hitl.subtitle: Require agent approval before the AI executes an automated resolution.
hitl.onDescription: the agent prepares the resolution and waits for a human agent to approve or reject it before executing.
hitl.offDescription: the agent resolves matching tickets immediately, no approval needed.

categories.title: Automatable categories
categories.subtitle: Only tickets in selected categories are eligible for AI auto-resolution.
